run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run the inference benchmark sweep across different GPU configurations using the CLI with --config and --num-gpus flags
run_benchmark_with_fixed_atoms: run the benchmark sweep with fixed atom counts using --natoms flag to specify total atoms per run
run_benchmark_with_per_gpu_atoms: run the benchmark sweep with per-GPU atom counts using --natoms-per-gpu flag to scale atoms by GPU count
run_benchmark_with_custom_overrides: run the benchmark sweep with additional config overrides using the --overrides flag for custom settings
run_benchmark_with_run_name: run the benchmark sweep with a custom run name using --run-name flag to label plot titles
